description.p: The graphical front-end for raven-install. It asks the questions the terminal installer asks -- the disk, the account, the timezone, the package profile -- shows the plan before anything is written, and then runs raven-install, which is what actually partitions the disk, copies the system and installs the bootloader.
The terminal installer remains available and does the same thing: this is a second way to drive it, not a second implementation of it.
